app_type: Data-Heavy SaaS Dashboard / ATS (Recruitment Tracking System)

theme_strategy.background_philosophy: Predominantly pure crisp white (#FFFFFF) with warm neutral accents (#F8FAFC, #F1F5F9). High contrast readability designed for serious B2B recruitment teams spending 8+ hours daily.
theme_strategy.primary_brand: Warm Orange / Saffron (#EA580C / #F97316 / #D97706) inspired by the Buddha meditation icon, evoking wisdom, warmth, energy, and intervention.
theme_strategy.border_and_divider: Delicate 1px borders (#E2E8F0) with crisp rounded corners, avoiding heavy dark dividers.

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900

spacing_and_layout.container_padding: px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6 max-w-7xl mx-auto
spacing_and_layout.bento_grid_protocol: Use asymmetric 12-column layouts for dashboards (col-span-8 for primary tables/charts, col-span-4 for AI suggestions and quick actions).
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-xl (12px) for cards, rounded-lg (8px) for buttons/inputs, rounded-full for status pills.

header_nav.type: Top-horizontal navigation with sticky blur overlay
header_nav.classes: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-200 px-6 py-3 shadow-xs
header_nav.logo_style: Flex container with Orange Buddha Meditation Icon + 'Career Buddha' in bold Plus Jakarta Sans font with saffron gradient accent tag 'Powerful Intervention'.

tabs.style: Underline or pill-style tabs with active orange bottom bar / orange background
tabs.active_tab: bg-orange-600 text-white font-semibold shadow-sm rounded-lg px-4 py-2
tabs.inactive_tab: text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-100 font-medium rounded-lg px-4 py-2 transition-all

candidate_table.style: Dense B2B data table with hover elevation
candidate_table.header_row: bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 font-semibold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider border-b border-slate-200 py-3.5 px-4
candidate_table.data_row: hover:bg-orange-50/40 border-b border-slate-100 transition-colors text-sm text-slate-800 py-3 px-4

online_offline_badge.online: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200
online_offline_badge.offline: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 border border-slate-200

buttons.primary: bg-orange-600 hover:bg-orange-700 text-white font-semibold px-4 py-2.5 rounded-lg shadow-sm hover:shadow transition-all duration-150 active:scale-[0.98]
buttons.secondary: bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-800 font-semibold px-4 py-2.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 shadow-2xs transition-all
buttons.ai_action: bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-500 to-orange-600 hover:from-amber-600 hover:to-orange-700 text-white font-semibold px-4 py-2 rounded-lg shadow-sm flex items-center gap-2

forms_and_inputs.input_field: w-full bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg px-3.5 py-2 text-sm text-slate-900 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-orange-500 focus:border-transparent transition-all shadow-2xs

modules_guidelines.resume_parser: Drag-and-drop resume upload zone with AI extraction breakdown displaying all 17 extracted candidate attributes in organized structured cards.
modules_guidelines.candidate_database: Unified searchable repository with instant multi-facet filter pills (CTC range, Notice Period, Industry, Skills, Location) and batch actions.
modules_guidelines.client_details: HR & Client Organisation Directory with quick mailto/tel action triggers and corporate profile cards.
modules_guidelines.business_development: Pipeline tracker with AI-Suggested HR Contacts based on target industries and daily log interactive timelines.
modules_guidelines.joining_details: Form per placement with real-time status update visible to assigned recruiter and single-admin.
modules_guidelines.advanced_search: Boolean & multi-parameter search engine with highlighted term matches and one-click resume download.
modules_guidelines.celebrations: Gamified team & candidate birthday / work anniversary wall with warm celebratory saffron card themes.
modules_guidelines.admin_console: Team member management grid with live websocket-style status indicators, access URL generator, and feature upgrade tier cards.

motion_and_animations.tab_switch: framer-motion opacity fade in + layoutId smooth slide indicator
motion_and_animations.toast: Use Sonner with orange border accent for success notifications

testing_protocol.data_testid_rule: MUST add data-testid in kebab-case to all interactive buttons, inputs, tabs, table rows, and status indicators (e.g. data-testid='tab-parse-resume', data-testid='admin-member-status-online', data-testid='candidate-resume-download-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the light theme with crisp WHITE background (#FFFFFF) and warm saffron/orange (#EA580C) brand accents.
Ensure all 7 tabs + Admin Console are fully implemented with realistic interactive mock functionality and sample ATS data.
Add data-testid attributes to all key components as specified in testing protocol.
Use Lucide React icons for clean B2B iconography.
Use standard JavaScript (.js / .jsx) components as specified for this React project.
